name: Item Editor
author: ct
description: Editor of the game's items (items_base, "Kind": "item") in the style of the other editor windows: the items of a writable mod in a searchable list with their pictures, a form with the name and the description in every language of the mod, price, picture picked from the items folders, item types and the use action; fields of other mods stay editable as JSON. New items, copies, deletion, undo, and a save the running game sees at once. Opens from the main menu tools and the in-game toolbar.
